summary: Neck expects Bitcoin to pull back to the 30-40k range (with $35k being a key monthly level) after the ETF hype, viewing current structure as distributive. He's long ETH expecting it to catch up to BTC once BTC stabilizes, but SOL has been outperforming with its meme coins capturing the rotation that was expected for ETH. GBTC outflows creating spot pressure but long-term view remains bullish for crypto in 2024.
